instructions.measurementWindowStart: Exact ISO-8601 start of the real measurement window. Do not copy regression fixture dates.
instructions.measurementWindowEnd: Exact ISO-8601 end of the real measurement window.
instructions.reactionSnapshotRunsPerDay: Owner-approved positive integer cadence with evidence.
instructions.cadenceEvidenceRef: Non-secret evidence reference for the approved cadence.
instructions.measurementWindowComplete: Explicit boolean completion state for the canonical measurement window. False is a real state, not Missing, and must keep quota promotion blocked.
instructions.observedThrough: Exact ISO-8601 observation boundary covered by the final measurement evidence. It must reach or exceed measurementWindowEnd before quota worksheet input can become ready.
instructions.measurementWindowCompletionEvidenceRef: Non-secret durable evidence reference proving the canonical window completed. Bounded snapshots from an incomplete window are not valid completion evidence.
instructions.measuredAt: Exact ISO-8601 timestamp when real quota usage measurements were completed.
instructions.uploadManifestPageCountPerReactionRun: Measured positive integer pages traversed across the selected audit cohort per reaction run.
instructions.videoCountPerReactionRun: Measured non-negative integer included-video count across the selected audit cohort per reaction run. Observed zero is valid evidence and must not be rewritten to Missing or one.
instructions.measuredUsageEvidenceRef: Non-secret evidence reference for measured page/video counts.
instructions.maxChannelIdsPerCall: Evidence-backed positive integer ID-filter batch limit. Do not infer from maxResults.
instructions.maxVideoIdsPerCall: Evidence-backed positive integer ID-filter batch limit. Do not infer from maxResults.
instructions.providerBatchLimitEvidenceRef: Non-secret provider evidence for both exact ID batch limits.
instructions.requestBatchingStrategy: Exact FANDEX client request batching strategy. singleton-only is a client behavior, not a provider maximum claim.
instructions.channelIdsPerCall: Positive integer channel IDs FANDEX will actually send per channels.list request.
instructions.videoIdsPerCall: Positive integer video IDs FANDEX will actually send per videos.list request.
instructions.requestBatchingEvidenceRef: Non-secret evidence reference for the declared FANDEX client batching behavior.
